title: Split Open listening guide
description: A guide, guides/<song id>/<slug>.yaml: a listening tour of a song as an ordered list of tips, each a passage, a mix and a note. See the Guides section of README.md. Beyond this schema, scripts/guides-index.py checks that a tip's end is after its start and that no player is both soloed and muted.

title.description: The guide's title, shown on its chip under the song.

lang.description: The language of the notes, as a code like en or fr (or pt-BR).

by.description: The author's name, shown after the title.

url.description: A link for the author's name.

tips.description: The tips in playing order. A later tip may start before the one before it ends, which replays the passage.

players.description: A player or a list of players.

to.description: Where it ends; without it, at the next tip.

solo.description: The players to solo for the passage.

mute.description: The players to mute for the passage.

gain.description: Fader levels for the passage, by player.

pause.description: true stops the music at the tip until the listener presses Continue.

note.description: What to listen for. Quote it if it holds a colon followed by a space, or a #.
